notes.title: Anniversary Special!
notes.content:
[h1]Happy Anniversary Tiny Lands![/h1] 
[h2]On January 22nd, Tiny Lands will be celebrating its first anniversary! yay![/h2] ːtinyloveː

During the last year, Tiny Lands has been growing and receiving a lot of feedback from the community and it has been a great journey. 

But what's a celebration without a present? ːtinythinkː

We would like to introduce to you "[b]Specials[/b]". ːtinyideaː 

[b]Once you have found all differences[/b], you will see a new icon in the title menu. You will find the anniversary diorama there ːtinyideaː 

Complete the anniversary diorama to get the special anniversary achievement ːtinyjutsuː

As always, we would like to thank the amazing community and the incredibly positive feedback we have received from players all around the world. ːtinyideaː

We hope you can enjoy Tiny Lands and have a great time finding the differences! No rush, no pressure, no timer, no punishment, just chill with a hot drink!  ːtinycoffeeː

Stay tuned on January 22nd!
Hyper Three Studio team

notes.title: FREE CONTENT UPDATE
notes.content:
We are happy to announce we are finally releasing a major update that includes new content to the game! 

As we promised this is totally free content for all the support received from the community!

[previewyoutube=8EFSSvdUkso;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Features[/b] ᕙ(⇀‸↼)ᕗ
[list]
[*] You can now [b]pan[/b] the scene view: 
[list]
[*] [b]Keyboard[/b]: Q and E to pan left or right
[*] [b]Keyboard[/b]: Press Q+E simultaneously to quickly go back to the center after panning
[*] [b]Mouse[/b]: Press the scroll wheel and move your mouse left or right to pan
[img]https://i.ibb.co/LR9Dt64/Pan-1.gif[/img]
[*] [b]Mouse[/b]: Click the new UI icon that will be displayed in the right-bottom screen area to quickly return to the center after panning
[img]https://i.ibb.co/Xz2rtr9/Pan-2.gif[/img]
[/list]
[*] [b]30 new handcrafted levels[/b], featuring Wild West, Space, and Sports themes.
[*] Added BGM and SFX volume control, these controls are now available in the main menu and each level for more customization.
[*] You can now hide/show the “Found” white box element along with the new BGM/SFX buttons for more comfort when playing a level. 
[/list]

[b]Bugs & fixes:[/b] (ಥ⌣ಥ)
[list]
[*] Fixed bug where you could move left and right while the picked level was loading.
[*] Fixed initial loading screen with dark mode.
[*] Fixed some BGM loops 
[/list]

Now grab your coffee and have more chill time with Tiny Lands! (っ˘ڡ˘ς) 

Thanks again for all the positive reviews and the love of this amazing community!
Best,
Hyper Three Studio team

notes.title: Patch notes: Version 1.0.1.2
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Fixed issue where players were unable to unlock a new world due to missing stars. If you experience this issue, you should have back your respective stars, just start the game and you will be able to continue unlocking worlds.

If anything rises up about this issue please do not hesitate to contact us so we can assist you. More information: https://steamcommunity.com/app/1354910/discussions/0/3106889614405021559/

[*]Fixed frozen screen when selecting “Language” when the initial screen animation was playing. 

[*]Fixed issue when trying to unlock a new world and using a different aspect ratio from 16:9

[*]Added “Dark/Light” mode

[*]Added Mouse support (Hold right-click to drag from left/right, Scroll Wheel to zoom in/out)

[*]You can now resize the window to fit your needs. Press  ALT+Enter and then adjust your desired window size. (If you do this in the “MENU” scene, the “red” option indicator will be misplaced, but once you hover the mouse on any option it will refresh position)
[/list]

notes.title: Upcoming patch news!
notes.content:
Dear Community
First of all, we want to thank everyone. We are amazed by the positive reviews and feedback, thanks also to the people who enjoy streaming the game on twitch and youtube. we had fun watching some of them.

But it is not time to relax for us as we believe this is only the first step for the game. We have big plans for it and to make it available for other platforms.

[b]Thanks to the community participation[/b] we have taken some feedback to improve the game for current and new players.

[b]Here is the list of the content we are currently working on[/b]:

[list]
[*] [b]Light/Dark mode[/b]: We know playing this at night (or in dark rooms) might illuminate your beautiful eyes too much ♨_♨, so we will implement a “Dark mode” that will affect only the scene of the main menu, level selection and the transition between scenes.

[*] [b]Mouse only support[/b]: You will now be able to [b]really grab your coffee cup[/b] and play with one hand, there will be no need to activate anything, you can still play with keyboard or mouse at your desire.  
(っ˘ڡ˘ς)
[/list]
[b]Special surprise content[/b]: We want to give back the love and support we have received to the community, so...prepare your eyes for new [b]free content[/b]! ( ͡° ͜ʖ ͡°). ([b]Content release will be announced later on[/b]) 

Again, we are very grateful for all your support! We are working hard so you can keep enjoying Tiny Lands!

notes.title: Minor patch 1.0.1.1
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed "Inspector" achievement conditions: The variables used for achievements are now per-session. Find 50 differences with less or equal 10 wrong clicks. 
[*] Minor UI adjustments.
[*] Fixed a small collider on an object causing a potential misclick.
[/list]

Thanks for your feedback!

notes.title: Tiny Lands is now available!
notes.content:
[h3]The day has come![/h3]
[b]We are happy to announce Tiny Lands is now available on STEAM![/b]

It has been a long journey since we started to develop Tiny Lands, with a lot of ups and downs through this pandemic time as a small indie studio. However, we are really happy with the final result of the game. We took our time to polish as much as we could and finally the game is ready to be on your computer! 

As an indie studio we hope for the best and we have big plans for the near future.

Every level was made with much love so you could just relax and chill out. We hope this game can brighten your day!

Like with many games, there's always a chance to find out bugs or maybe you can give us some amazing feedback which will help the game to become more incredible! Please, we highly recommend using the steam community discussions to let us know anything that comes up. We will try to reply as much as we can! 

We will soon announce a small feature for Streamers so stay tuned!

Sincerely,
[i]Isaac and Abraham from Hyper Three Studio[/i]

notes.content:
Dear friends!

We are very excited to announce our game Tiny Lands officially will be available on:
[h1] January 22, 2021[/h1]

We do really hope you have a good and relaxing time playing each one of the levels from Tiny Lands. Grab a cup of coffee and just chill out at home playing this title that was made with much love. 

[i]- Isaac and Abraham of Hyper Three Studio team[/i]
